title: Dr Frost Arctic Blueberry Raspberry Ice 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Dr Frost Arctic Shortfill Blueberry Raspberry Ice combines the juicy sweetness of Blueberries with the tart, tangy notes of Raspberries, perfectly finished with a frosty menthol exhale. This layered and refreshing e-liquid is perfect for vapers seeking bold, fruity flavours with a crisp icy twist. Part of Dr Frost’s Arctic Edition collection, this shortfill features double-concentrated ‘Bar Salts’ flavour to replicate the bold, intense taste profiles found in disposable vapes. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, it’s designed for low-powered Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices and pod kits. The 100ml bottle provides space for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing users to tailor their nicotine strength or enjoy it nicotine-free. Dr Frost Arctic Shortfills are a versatile and economical option for adult smokers and vapers who appreciate bold, refreshing flavour.
